target: call_sol.sh — the OpenRouter request bounds max_tokens; without it OpenRouter reserves credit against the provider ceiling and a credit-limited key is rejected outright (observed live 2026-08-10)
cmd: D="$PWD/req.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -e '.max_tokens == 2000' "$D"
